title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your profile, organization, and team access.

integrations.no_org: Join or create an organization to manage integrations.

dynamics.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / CE)
dynamics.subtitle: Pull contacts from your Dataverse tenant into the customer picker on demand. Imports are operator-driven — picking a contact creates or refreshes a local customer record.
dynamics.enabled_label: Enable the Dynamics customer picker for this organization
dynamics.dataverse_url_hint: e.g. https://your-tenant.crm.dynamics.com — no trailing slash needed.
dynamics.tenant_id_hint: Directory ID from Azure portal → Microsoft Entra ID → Overview.
dynamics.client_id_hint: From the app registration you created for Vita NPD.
dynamics.client_secret_placeholder: Paste the client secret value here
dynamics.client_secret_hint: Encrypted at rest. Leave blank when editing other fields to keep the stored value.
dynamics.test_button_hint: Sends a single WhoAmI request to confirm auth + reachability.
dynamics.test_button_disabled_hint: Save the configuration first, then test.
dynamics.saved: Saved. Test the connection to verify the credentials work.
dynamics.test_ok: Connection successful. The customer picker will now suggest Dynamics contacts.
dynamics.disable_confirm: Disable the Dynamics integration? The stored credentials are erased. Customers already imported keep working.
dynamics.disabled: Integration disabled. The customer picker will fall back to local results only.
dynamics.footer_note: The picker only calls Dynamics after a user types at least two characters. Outages and rate-limit hits degrade silently to local-only results so a Dynamics issue never blocks the proposal flow.

modules.members_description: Who else can sign in, invite new people, and change these permissions.
modules.catalogues_description: Raw materials, packaging, and any custom reference tables — scoped per catalogue.
modules.formulations_description: Build projects, save versions, approve spec sheets, run QC validations.
modules.proposals_description: Customer-facing proposal pipeline — list, edit, approve, sign, browse approvals queue and signed archive. Split from Projects so commercial roles can own this workflow without project-edit rights.
modules.audit_description: Read the org-wide trail of every write across catalogues, projects, spec sheets, trial batches, and QC validations.
modules.no_row_scopes: No catalogues exist yet — create one to scope access.

members.view: See the team roster and each member's role.
members.invite: Send invitations to new teammates by email.
members.edit_permissions: Change which capabilities other members have.
members.remove: Revoke a member's access to this organization.

catalogues.view: Open the catalogue table and read its rows.
catalogues.edit: Create, edit, and archive individual rows.
catalogues.import: Run the bulk Excel import to load many rows at once.
catalogues.manage_fields: Add, edit, or archive attribute definitions (the columns of the catalogue).
catalogues.delete: Permanently remove rows. Cannot be undone.

formulations.view: Read formulations, spec sheets, proposals, trial batches, and QC records.
formulations.edit: Create and edit formulations, spec sheets, proposals, trial batches, and QC records.
formulations.approve: Move documents through draft → in review → approved → sent. Required to send a proposal or spec sheet to a customer.
formulations.delete: Permanently remove a formulation or any of its child documents.
formulations.view_approvals: Open the org-wide inbox showing every document currently waiting for a signature.
formulations.view_signed: Open the customer-signed archive showing what's been sent out and what's come back signed.
formulations.assign_sales_person: Pick or change the commercial owner (sales rep) of a project. Split out so sales managers can reassign accounts without spec-edit rights.
formulations.manage_spec_visibility: Toggle individual sections (Nutrition, Microbiology, etc.) on or off for the customer-facing spec sheet.
formulations.sign_spec: Apply your signature to a spec sheet or proposal in any internal slot (Scientist, R&D Manager, Product Manager, Director). Without this, the signature pad is read-only.
formulations.comments_view: Read comment threads on any project entity.
formulations.comments_write: Post comments and reply. You can always edit, delete, or resolve your own threads.
formulations.comments_moderate: Edit, delete, or resolve OTHER users' comment threads. The moderator role — typically team leads only.

proposals.view: Read the proposals list, individual proposals, and the customer-facing PDF.
proposals.edit: Create proposals, edit lines, customer info, pricing, and acknowledgements. Render and re-render the PDF.
proposals.approve: Director-only. Flip a proposal from In review → Approved by signing as Director. Send-to-client is separately governed by Edit.
proposals.sign: Apply your signature to a proposal in any internal slot (Scientist, R&D Manager, Product Manager, Director). The customer signature on the public kiosk is gated by the link, not by this capability.
proposals.view_approvals: Open the proposals tab of the org-wide approvals inbox showing every proposal waiting for a signature.
proposals.view_signed: Open the proposals tab of the customer-signed archive showing what's been sent out and what's come back signed.
proposals.manual_close: Override the kiosk flow and manually mark a Sent proposal as Accepted or Rejected (e.g. when the customer responded by phone or email). Usually granted to commercial leads or the director.

audit.view: Read the org-wide log of every write across catalogues, projects, spec sheets, trial batches, and QC.

members.invite: Settings → Members → Invite member button + pending invitation actions (Resend, Revoke).
members.edit_permissions: Settings → Members → Edit permissions drawer. Also gates access to Settings → Integrations (Dynamics / future third-party config).
members.remove: Settings → Members → Remove member action on each row.

catalogues.view: Catalogues → [catalogue] table (read-only access to rows + attribute definitions).
catalogues.edit: Catalogues → [catalogue] → Edit / New row buttons + inline cell editing + archive toggle.
catalogues.manage_fields: Catalogues → [catalogue] → Fields tab (add / edit / archive attribute definitions).

formulations.view: Projects list (/formulations). Every Project tab — Overview, Builder, Spec sheets, Proposals, Trial batches, QC. Spec sheet read view. Trial batch + QC validation read views.
formulations.edit: Save / Edit / New buttons on every Project tab. Duplicate project flow. Builder line + picker edits. Spec sheet & trial batch creation. QC validation entry.
formulations.approve: Approve action on Spec sheet detail. Sets status → approved → sent. Required before a spec sheet can be shared with a customer.
formulations.delete: Delete buttons on Projects list, Spec sheets list, Trial batches list, QC list, and Proposals list (proposals delete is the paired half — granting either covers both).
formulations.view_approvals: Approvals page (/approvals) — surfaces BOTH the Spec sheets tab AND the Proposals tab. Paired with Proposals → View approvals queue (granting either covers both).
formulations.view_signed: Signed documents page (/signed) — surfaces BOTH the Spec sheets tab AND the Proposals tab. Paired with Proposals → View signed documents.
formulations.assign_sales_person: Assign sales person dropdown on every Project header. Covers both project and proposal-level assignment (proposals reuse the project's sales person).
formulations.manage_spec_visibility: Spec sheet detail → Section visibility editor (toggles client-facing sections like Nutrition / Microbiology).
formulations.sign_spec: Internal signature slots on Spec sheet detail (Scientist / R&D Manager / Product Manager / Director). Paired with Proposals → Sign proposal — same toggle covers both.
formulations.comments_view: Floating chat bubble on every Project page (Overview, Builder, Spec sheets, Proposals, Trial batches, QC). Spec sheet → comments thread.
formulations.comments_write: Compose + reply in the project chat bubble and the spec sheet thread. Authors always retain edit / delete / resolve on their own posts regardless of this grant.
formulations.comments_moderate: Edit / delete / resolve OTHER users' comments anywhere a thread appears. The moderator role — typically team leads + owners only.

proposals.view: Proposals list (/proposals). Proposal detail page. Customers list (/customers) and customer create/edit modals. Customer picker on Spec sheet + Proposal forms.
proposals.edit: New proposal button on Project → Proposals tab. Edit proposal lines, pricing, customer info, acknowledgements. Send-to-client button on the proposal detail page.
proposals.approve: Approve button on the Proposal detail page (In review state). Gates the in_review → approved transition that lands the director signature on the proposal.
proposals.delete: Delete button on the Proposals list. Paired with Projects → Delete.
proposals.sign: Internal signature slot on Proposal detail (Scientist / R&D Manager / Product Manager / Director). Paired with Projects → Sign spec sheet.
proposals.view_approvals: Paired with Projects → View approvals queue. Granting either covers the full /approvals page (both tabs).
proposals.view_signed: Paired with Projects → View signed documents. Granting either covers the full /signed page (both tabs).
proposals.manual_close: Manual override on a Sent proposal: flip it to Accepted or Rejected from the staff UI when the customer responded by phone or email instead of via the kiosk.

audit.view: Settings → Audit log (org-wide immutable trail of every write across catalogues, projects, spec sheets, trial batches, QC, comments, and integration changes).

role_presets.members: Owners have all of these implicitly. Most members only need View. Grant Invite and Edit permissions to admins / team leads.
role_presets.catalogues: Scientist: View + Edit on raw_materials & packaging. Bulk import for whoever loads new supplier sheets. Manage fields and Hard delete are admin-only.
role_presets.formulations: Scientist: View, Edit, Sign spec sheet, Comments view + write. R&D Manager / Director: everything above + Approve & send + Comments moderate. Read-only stakeholder: View only. (Sales typically does not need any Projects capability — they live in the Proposals module instead.)
role_presets.proposals: Sales: View, Edit, View approvals queue, View signed. Sales lead: everything above + Manually close. Director: everything above + Approve + Sign proposal. Scientist: usually only Sign proposal so they can sign the internal slot when handed a draft. Read-only stakeholder: View only. ("Assign sales person" is granted under Projects — same toggle covers both modules.)
role_presets.audit: Compliance and QA leads. Owners get it implicitly.
